create_dataset_files: create a new TensorFlow dataset directory with all template files from a dataset name
register_subparser: register the tfds new CLI subparser with dataset name and data format arguments
create_dataset_test: create a dataset builder test file with fake train and test splits
create_dataset_readme: create a README.md file with markdown description placeholder for the dataset
create_dataset_citations: create a CITATIONS.bib file with BibTeX citation placeholder for the dataset
